entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: "Do you think this is right? Do you say, 'My righteousness is more than God's'?

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: For you say, 'What advantage will it be to You? What profit shall I have, more than [if] I had sinned?'

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: "I will answer you, And your companions with you.

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Look to the heavens and see; And behold the clouds-They are higher than you.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If you sin, what do you accomplish against Him? Or, [if] your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to Him?

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If you are righteous, what do you give Him? Or what does He receive from your hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Your wickedness affects a man such as you, And your righteousness a son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: ¶"Because of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry out for help because of the arm of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But no one says, 'Where [is] God my Maker, Who gives songs in the night,

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, And makes us wiser than the birds of heaven?'

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they cry out, but He does not answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: Surely God will not listen to empty [talk], Nor will the Almighty regard it.

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: ¶Although you say you do not see Him, [Yet] justice [is] before Him, and you must wait for Him.

entries.title: Job 35:15
segments: And now, because He has not punished in His anger, Nor taken much notice of folly,

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: Therefore Job opens his mouth in vain; He multiplies words without knowledge."
